name: CNAP Reporting Hub Survey

about: The CNAP Reporting Hub is this site, where you complete your Center surveys and reports.
Please tell us what makes reporting easy or hard, so we can improve it.

sections.title: Survey questions
sections.instructions: Please indicate how much you agree with each statement about the CNAP Reporting Hub.

questions.prompt: It is easy to report things within the CNAP Reporting Hub.
The communications sent by the CNAP Reporting Hub are informative.
Information is clearly labeled within the CNAP Reporting Hub.
What are things that are functioning well regarding the CNAP Reporting Hub?
What are things that could be improved regarding the CNAP Reporting Hub?

_source: Team_Science.pdf (Piestar export), split into four surveys (MW, 2026-10-24); open-ended prompts reworded per topic.
